## Outcome and ownership

Describe the user-visible change and whether it belongs in One, Core or an App.

## Evidence

- [ ] `npm run verify`
- [ ] UI build/types and relevant tests
- [ ] Native/package readback for affected platforms (state what was not checked)
- [ ] Existing data IDs/keys/paths, offline access and export preserved
- [ ] Apache/third-party notices and package provenance preserved

## Review notes

Include screenshots for visible changes, reproduction steps and remaining gates.
Keep logs synthetic/redacted. AI-assisted work needs an accountable human reviewer.
Do not claim planned account, marketplace or Business services are implemented.
